lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting today.
You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Golden Sweet Potato Dahl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of the dahl and a portion of the rice together until piping hot.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting vegan meal that is naturally free from one of the foods on your medical list.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Pepper Rice
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken and peppers with basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, peppers and rice. Squeeze the lemon juice over the top before serving.
dishes.why: A protein-rich dish for Roxane that respects her need for a separate plate.

dishes.name: Creamy Coconut Dahl Bowl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of the dahl and rice in a pan or microwave until steaming.
dishes.why: Warm and filling for a late Wednesday evening without using an oven.

dishes.name: Savoury Chicken and Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken and peppers with basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and pepper mix with the rice. Serve with the vegetables first as requested.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner for Roxane that follows her specific serving order.

dishes.method: Reheat the dahl and rice until hot. The sweet potatoes will be extra tender today.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting end to the stretch for the shared table.

dishes.name: Warm Chicken and Pepper Rice
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken and peppers with basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat the final portion of chicken and peppers with rice.
dishes.why: A consistent, warm dinner for Roxane that meets her dietary requirements.

preparations.title: Sweet Potato and Red Lentil Dahl
preparations.method: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add the sweet potatoes, lentils, spices, and coconut milk with 500ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in the spinach at the end until wilted.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Chicken and Peppers
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Brown the chicken thighs until cooked through. Add the onions, garlic, and bell peppers, sautéing until the vegetables are tender but still bright.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Add to a large pot with 1.5 litres of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 12-15 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice in a large pot. While it simmers, begin the dahl in another large pot by sautéing onions and adding lentils and sweet potatoes. While both pots simmer, sear the chicken and peppers in a large pan. Once the rice is done, fluff and box it. Stir spinach into the dahl and box. Finally, box the chicken and pepper mixture.
